acceptance: Same frozen weights, mapping and prompt tokens across policies.
Per-response independent seeded generator; resume must reproduce sampling.
Greedy compatibility test against existing decoder.
No expert loads during restricted response; original cache may swap.
Do not execute generated code on host.
Store every seed and output; report per prompt and policy, never select best seed.
limitations: Nine already inspected development prompts, not an independent test.
Sampling can reduce repetition without restoring correctness.
Temperature and nucleus jointly define one policy; no claim isolating their individual effects.
No reference CE improvement attributed to decoding: teacher-forced logits unchanged.
Variable output lengths and original swapping prevent a simple speedup claim.
Recovery variants deferred until validated training; this control does not validate corpus.
